visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Bullets are still there
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The menu should be plain text without bullets, but each item still shows a dot. The rule for the list style uses a value that the browser does not know.

solution.explanation: The value none removes the marker. A word that is not a valid value (nope) makes the declaration invalid, so the default disc stays. Check the value spelling when a rule seems to be ignored.
